object_description: two-stage composition of interacting building volumes
design_condition: The volumes interact with the existing buildings and create several external spaces, including a well-defined entrance square, but other spaces remain diffuse or functionally unclear, particularly between the buildings and at the lower level.

positive.statement: The tree-lined gravel square at the entrance is well defined and of high quality.

position.rationale: Upper separated slab and adjacent open margin approximate the entrance square.

positive.statement: The portico supports the entrance square and can accommodate various events.

position.rationale: Narrow articulated strip beside lower volume reads as the entrance-supporting portico.

positive.statement: The search for construction solutions aimed at containing costs is appreciated.

position.rationale: Cost containment is a global construction judgment.

negative.statement: The external spaces created by the volumes are not consistently defined or interesting.

position.rationale: Multiple open gaps between separated volumes are clearly visible.

negative.statement: The lower-level space between the two buildings has no clear function.

position.target: lower-level space between the two buildings
position.rationale: Lower gap is constrained between masses, but its program is not visible.

negative.statement: The organization and functionality of the first-stage internal spaces are unconvincing, particularly because the routes are complex and problematic.

position.rationale: Interior routes are hidden; lower footprint provides an approximate first-stage anchor.

negative.statement: The division of the buildings into the two stages, especially the underground part, is not precise.

position.rationale: Separated volumes suggest staging, while underground extent is not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The cost-oriented construction solutions do not achieve the desired architectural quality.

position.target: cost-oriented construction solutions and architectural quality
position.rationale: Combines global cost and expression evaluation without one spatial referent.
